description: Shutdown must run in reverse dependency order with a timeout per plugin. A plugin whose shutdown hook hangs must not block shutdown of already-completed plugins and must be reported, not silently swallowed.
notes: 051 plan section 9: 'shutdown 依 dependency graph 反向執行並有 timeout'. registerOrder mirrors the concrete PL0-02 dependency chain audit -> auth -> rbac/m2m -> mcp-server captured in 051-pl0-snapshot-summary.md.
